programs.title: Flavors of China·Hometown Flavors Ep.2
programs.desc: As part of the \"Flavors of China\" series, this episode explores hometown flavors through regional cooking styles. Each lovingly made dish reveals the secrets of a unique local food culture, conveying the deep connection Chinese people have to home and hearth.

programs.title: The Grand Canal Ep.3
programs.desc: With the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal as longitude and its 3,000-year history as latitude, this series traces the canal's development from multiple angles, tells the life stories of those along its banks, and reveals the unique status of this world cultural heritage.
